properties.project_name: 700 Indiana St -- MBC BioLabs lab/office building (adjacent to Pier 70)
properties.digitized_from: The real DataSF Assessor parcel for blklot 4062007 (700 Indiana St, Dogpatch), taken from DataSF's Assessor parcel data on 2026-09-28. The polygon itself is the real, unmodified Assessor shape.
properties.regulatory_context: SF Planning Case No. 2023-001074ENX. Planning Commission approved the project 2024-06-13 (Motion No. 21576): a 3-story-plus-basement, ~70,650-72,350 gross sq ft lab/office building (sources give slightly different figures) replacing an existing ~15,068 sq ft one-story building, for MBC BioLabs. A neighborhood appeal of the CEQA general plan evaluation exemption was rejected by the Board of Supervisors 9-1 on 2024-09-24 (Supervisor Walton dissenting), clearing the project to proceed. No DataSF building permit found as of 2026-09-28, so construction has apparently not yet started.
properties.notes: Developer: Dewey Land Company (purchased the site 2022 for $15M). End tenant: MBC BioLabs. Architect: MBH Architects.
